reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and this one names the lab and puts the batch report behind a QR code, which is more than most supplements give me. The empty-box refund and the launch price make one box an easy thing to try.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? A lab report shows what is in the capsule, not that it does anything for me, and I'd still want my doctor to say the dose is right.
